name: Differential Edge Sampling
aliases: Boundary Path Integral Estimation via Edge Sampling
definition: A method to compute the gradient of the rendering equation w.r.t. scene parameters by decomposing the derivative into an interior integral (estimated via auto-diff) and a boundary integral (estimated by explicitly sampling visibility discontinuities).
summary: Differential Edge Sampling computes rendering gradients by explicitly sampling visibility discontinuities at geometric boundaries, distinguishing itself from vertex-based methods through bidirectional seed ray generation.
